rule_text: Hospital Administrators is not allowed to establish new Staff records.
The system allows Hospital Admins to generate Clinical Protocol entries.
Hospital Administrators can create collaborations details between employees.
Hospital Admins are authorized to insert Billing Records provided the amount exceeds 1000.
Hospital Admins can form new ownership connections if the 'since' year is greater than 2000.
Administrators at the hospital are allowed to create any type of node.
Nurses have the right to generate Medical Document records.
Nurses are authorized to view Medical Documents.
Nurses are explicitly prohibited from accessing or browsing Medical Documents.
Nurses can add 'owns' links between entities."
Nurses have permission to inspect any kind of connection.
Nurses are not allowed to traverse 'owns' associations.
Data Analysts are granted the ability to make any type of relationship.
Data Analysts can explore 'connected' relationships.
Data Analysts are blocked from browsing any relationships.
Data Analysts may create any node, as long as its level attribute is less than 5.
Data Analysts can read Clinical Protocol entries.
Data Analysts are forbidden from viewing any node types.
IT Engineers can instantiate any node.
IT Engineers are permitted to browse Staff profiles.
IT Engineers have authorization to create any relationship.
IT Engineers can access 'assigned to' connections where the year falls after 2020 and before 2018.
Equipment Managers may view Medical Equipment items.
Equipment Managers can add new Medical Equipment records.
Data Analysts are restricted from viewing Patient Confidential Records.
Profile Editors can append an email to Patient Accounts if they are marked as the owner.
Profile Editors are allowed to see the email on Patient Accounts.
Contact Managers can attach a phone number to 'has contact' links.
Address Editors may input an address on a Patient Account, assuming they are the owner.
Address Editors can view the address field of Patient Accounts.
Address Editors are forbidden from reading any information on Patient Accounts.
Doctors can append a diagnosis to a Medical Record, provided they are the assigned physician.
Doctors have permission to check diagnoses on Medical Records.
Doctors are prohibited from viewing diagnoses within Medical Records.
Order Managers can add any properties to Medical Order relationships if their user ID matches the owner ID.
Order Managers can review the status of Medical Orders.
HR Managers can create Staff profiles if the person's age is simultaneously over 60 and under 18.
HR Managers are allowed to make Staff records when the employment status is both active and inactive.
HR Managers can establish Staff entries when the 'false' condition is met.
HR Managers may add Staff records if the salary is strictly greater than 5000 and less than or equal to 5000.
Auditors have permission to inspect Billing Records exceeding 1000 in amount.
Auditors can browse Billing Records where the amount is over 500.
Auditors may review Billing Records that are larger than 2000.
Auditors can view User Accounts for individuals older than 30.
Auditors are granted access to browse User Accounts for people aged 18 to 65 inclusive.
Auditors may examine User Accounts belonging to users between 25 and 40 years of age.
Auditors can check completed Medical Orders that cost more than 100.
Auditors are authorized to read Medical Orders with a 'completed' status.
Auditors can look into completed Medical Orders valued above 500.
Auditors can inspect Medical Equipment with a value surpassing 1000.
Auditors are permitted to explore Medical Equipment valued over 500.
Auditors can read Medical Equipment logs if the value is negative and simultaneously greater than 100.
Auditors may view Medical Documents that are not marked as confidential.
Auditors have the right to access confidential Medical Documents.
Auditors can review Medical Documents owned by the admin.
Auditors are allowed to check Staff records where the age is exactly 18.
Auditors can browse Staff profiles with a level strictly greater than 3 but no more than 4.
Auditors may examine Staff records earning salaries exactly 5000 and somehow over 5000.
Nurses can generate new Patient Activity logs.
Nurses are allowed to review Patient Activity entries.
Nurses are restricted from viewing Patient Activities with a score over 80.
Medical Editors are empowered to erase archived Medical Documents.
Medical Editors may update the status of Medical Documents.
Resource Managers are barred from deleting the 'status' property on 'owns' connections if the active flag is false.
Resource Managers have authorization to strip the 'active' property from 'owns' relationships.
System Supervisors can create User Accounts with a level of 5 or higher.
System Supervisors are allowed to populate the 'level' attribute on User Accounts.
Content Moderators can set up Clinical Notes as long as the visibility is private.
Content Moderators are permitted to edit any detail on Clinical Notes.
Auditors can examine Patient Accounts possessing a balance of zero or less.
Auditors have the ability to alter any data within Patient Accounts.
Compliance Officers can eliminate 'transfers' relationships if the transferred amount exceeds 10000.
Compliance Officers are denied the ability to modify any 'transfers' connections.
HR Assistants can update the salary field on Staff records.
HR Assistants are permitted to add salary information to Staff entries.
HR Assistants can clear out any property on a Staff node.
Junior Data Analysts are prohibited from changing the date on 'reports to' links.
Junior Data Analysts can append dates to 'reports to' associations.
Junior Data Analysts are allowed to delete any attribute from 'reports to' relationships.
Support Agents are forbidden to edit any part of a Patient Profile.
Support Agents can attach a phone number to a Patient Profile.
Support Agents may remove the phone number from Patient Profiles.
Payroll Clerks cannot alter a Staff member's salary.
Payroll Clerks can insert a salary value into Staff nodes.
Payroll Clerks are authorized to delete the salary property from Staff records.
Billing Clerks are prevented from updating the credit limit on Patient Accounts.
Billing Clerks can add a credit limit to Patient Accounts.
Billing Clerks may wipe the credit limit from Patient Accounts.
IT Support staff are not allowed to change the role of a User Account.
IT Support can add a role designation to User Accounts.
IT Support has the right to remove the role from User Accounts.
Payroll Clerks can read the salary details of Staff members.
Billing Clerks are allowed to see the credit limit on Patient Accounts.
IT Support can view the role assigned to User Accounts.
Senior Doctors can delete Patient records once the status is 'discharged'.
Senior Doctors are allowed to update a Patient's status.
Chief Physicians can remove 'prescribes' associations if the dosage is greater than 500.
Chief Physicians can adjust any details on a 'prescribes' relationship.
Risk Managers can discard Security Events rated with a severity of 4 or higher.
Risk Managers are empowered to edit all aspects of Security Events.
Senior Doctors can erase critical Security Events.
Senior Doctors may change the status of Security Events.
Medical Interns are not permitted to register Patients who are under 18.
Medical Interns can modify any detail on a Patient record.
Medical Interns can establish any type of node.
Medical Interns can access records for stable Patients.
Medical Interns are barred from deleting Patients in critical condition.
Medical Interns are prohibited from removing Patient files unless the status is not discharged or it is critical.
Head Physicians can delete 'treats' links when the priority level is 5 or above.
Head Physicians can add any properties to a TREATS record.
Head Physicians can inspect active 'treats' relationships.
Head Physicians are allowed to update the status of 'treats' associations.
Billing Managers can generate Treatment entries costing more than 10000.
Billing Managers can alter the cost of Treatments.
Billing Managers have permission to discard unapproved Treatment records.
Billing Managers can attach any attribute to a Treatment record.
Doctors can form 'prescribes' connections if the dosage is over 500.
Doctors can clear the dosage attribute from 'prescribes' links.
Doctors are permitted to view 'prescribes' associations that occur on a daily frequency.
Doctors can edit any field on 'prescribes' relationships.
